/*
NEW DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: TO CALL 'LOV_DCLTN_ALL' FORM
PROGRAMMER : Omar Hasan
VERSION : 1.
DATE : 1-4-1423
*/
DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLTN_ALL';
 RET NUMBER;
 D DATE;
 P_COUNT NUMBER(10);
BEGIN
IF :P_DCLTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
IF :P_DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT(DCLTN_NBR)
 INTO P_COUNT 
 FROM DECLARATIONS 
 WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT AND DCLTN_NBR=:P_DCLTN_NBR AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD=:P_DCLTN_TYPE;

END IF;

IF P_COUNT =1 THEN
 SELECT D.DCLTN_ISN,D.DCLTN_DT,D.IMPR_NBR,I.ARBC_IMPR_NAME
 INTO :P_DCLTN_ISN,:P_DCLTN_DT ,:P_IMPR_NBR,:P_IMPR_NAME
 FROM DECLARATIONS D,IMPORTERS I
 WHERE D.PORT_CD=:PORT AND D.DCLTN_NBR=:P_DCLTN_NBR AND
 D.IMPR_NBR=I.IMPR_NBR AND
 D.PORT_CD=I.PORT_CD;

ELSIF P_COUNT >1 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة اختيار بيانات محددة ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 
 -- IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD != 99 THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_TYPE_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_NBR);
 -- ELSE
 -- NULL;
 -- END IF;
 
 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN_ALL.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 D :=:GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT;
 :P_DCLTN_ISN:=:GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 :P_DCLTN_NBR:=:GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR ;
 :P_DCLTN_DT :=D;--TO_CHAR(D,'MI-MM-RRRR');
 :P_IMPR_NBR :=:GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR;
 BEGIN
 SELECT ARBC_IMPR_NAME INTO :P_IMPR_NAME FROM IMPORTERS WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT AND
 IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 :P_IMPR_NAME :=NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 150,'ERROR');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END IF;
END;

/*
NEW DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: 
PROGRAMMER : Omar Hasan
VERSION : 1.
DATE : 1-4-1423
*/
DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 P_PORT VARCHAR2(200);
 P_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);

 --:FINANCE_DT := revenue.get_fiscal_year_start(:start_dt);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:port);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'INS_TYP',TEXT_PARAMETER,:INS_TYP);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_ISN',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_ISN);
 
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'to_d_h',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 
 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'st_year_fin',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:FINANCE_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 
END;
